transactions.desc: The Dodgers optioned Barnes to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Tuesday.
Snell (elbow) was activated from the 60-day injured list ahead of his start Tuesday night against the Royals.
The Giants designated Leonard for assignment Tuesday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
San Francisco reinstated Bericoto (oblique) from the 10-day injured list on Tuesday.
The Red Sox reinstated Rutschman (wrist) from the 10-day injured list Tuesday and added him to the active roster, Gabrielle Starr of the Boston Herald reports.
The Giants optioned Morgan to Triple-A Sacramento on Tuesday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
Boston designated Rogers for assignment on Tuesday, per Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com.
Knizner signed a major-league contract with the Giants on Tuesday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
The Rangers selected Kelenic's contract from Triple-A Round Rock on Tuesday.
The Rangers designated Bride for assignment Tuesday.
The Pirates reinstated Yorke (shoulder) from the 7-day injured list Tuesday, Dominic Campbell of SI.com reports.
The Brewers signed Wilson to one-year contract Tuesday.
The Brewers designated Richardson for assignment Tuesday.
The Yankees recalled Hanner from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Tuesday.
The Astros optioned Meyers to Triple-A Sugar Land on Tuesday, Julia Morales of Space City Home Network reports.
Colorado designated Julien for assignment on Tuesday, per Kyle Newman of The Denver Post.
The Rockies recalled Veen from Triple-A Albuquerque on Tuesday, Kyle Newman of The Denver Post reports.
Philadelphia demoted Rangel to Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Tuesday, Todd Zolecki of MLB.com reports.
The Tigers released Gentry on Tuesday, Emily Waldon of Baseball America reports.
Philadelphia recalled McFarlane from Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Tuesday, Todd Zolecki of MLB.com reports.
The Reds optioned McCambley to Triple-A Louisville on Tuesday.
The Reds selected Toglia's contract from Triple-A Louisville on Tuesday.
Cincinnati reinstated Lodolo (finger) from the 15-day injured list, and he will start Tuesday's matchup against the White Sox.
The Blue Jays recalled Lee from Triple-A Buffalo on Tuesday, per Keegan Matheson of MLB.com.
The Tigers selected Rainey's contract from Triple-A Toledo on Tuesday.
The Athletics claimed Rom off waivers Tuesday.
The Marlins recalled Pauley from Triple-A Jacksonville on Tuesday, Kevin Barral of FishonFirst.com reports.
Woodford agreed to a minor-league contract with the Rays on Monday, Marc Topkin of the Tampa Bay Times reports.
The Blue Jays released Alcala on Tuesday.
The Giants selected Morgan's contract from Triple-A Sacramento ahead of Monday's game against the Astros, Alex Pavlovic of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
